body:
console.html: 'Get provisioning URL' button on the SIP account panel. MainActivity.java: new SipBridge.registerFromProvisioningUrl(url) fetches the real capability-URL payload natively (avoids file://-origin CORS issues), extracts extension/server/port/password, calls the same doRegister() helper register() uses (extracted via refactor). index.html/app.js: new 'Provisioning URL' field at the top of Config, paste one URL + tap Register, done -- manual fields now under an '-- or configure manually --' divider. Backend: IDUNA_PRO commit 4e82985 (GET /api/v1/sip-accounts/me/provisioning-url mints an HMAC capability token, public GET /api/v1/sip-provisioning/{token} serves the real payload including password, sourced from an operator env var SIP_SECRETS_JSON, never hand-typed). Real bug found and fixed before shipping: minted URL was missing nginx's /console-api prefix, would have routed to the wrong service. CI green, v0.36.0 released. CarePyre commit f277d83.

⚓ ☃
title: SIP phone registers from a single console-generated provisioning URL
